headline: 《愛的假設》影評普通
context: 亞馬遜新片《愛的假設》（The Love Hypothesis），改編自艾莉‧海澤伍德（Ali Hazelwood）的 BookTok 暢銷小說，由莉莉‧萊茵哈特（Lili Reinhart）飾演史丹佛生物博士生奧莉薇‧史密斯（Olive Smith）。影評普遍認為，萊茵哈特雖然賣力演出，但整部片仍缺乏火花。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Riverdale’s Lili Reinhart does some heavy lifting in adaptation of Ali Hazelwood’s hit book, but it’s not quite enough Fans of the dearly departed Riverdale – or, moreover, admirers of all the batshit things the CW comic soap could make its bright young actors say with straining sincerity – have long rooted for Lili Reinhart. The Betty Cooper of yore was the best of that talented crop (Charles Melton and Camila Mendes among them) at rising above her subpar surroundings, her impressively expressive eyes able to sell the unsellable with complete conviction. She is the type of helplessly endearing performer suited to roles of naivety who masks surprise steeliness, as in her notable turn in 2019’s Hustlers or, better yet, romcoms, though there remains a dearth of worthy material. (A dual role in 2022’s Look Both Ways , a Netflix homage to Sliding Doors, didn’t cut it.) At least on paper, The Love Hypothesis, a new romcom from Amazon Prime Video, should be that material. The BookTok sensation by neuroscientist turned author Ali Hazelwood presents an ideal Reinhart protagonist: extremely nerdy, in a periodic table way, yet conventionally beautiful, awkward and self-deprecating yet cutting when it counts, the type of sweet-presenting young woman who will shout “fuck” repeatedly in private. Which Reinhart’s Olive Smith, a young biology PhD student at Stanford, winsomely does in the film’s unsettlingly cold open, as a bleary-eyed Olive, blind from expired contacts, freaking out before her grad school interview and then boldly stating her cancer-solving intentions to a brusque, handsome professor in a lab bathroom. thread_text:
亞馬遜新片《愛的假設》（The Love Hypothesis），改編自艾莉‧海澤伍德（Ali Hazelwood）的 BookTok 暢銷小說，由《河谷鎮》女星莉莉‧萊茵哈特（Lili Reinhart）飾演史丹佛生物博士生奧莉薇‧史密斯（Olive Smith），為了向朋友證明論點，跟一名教授假扮情侶。影評普遍認為，萊茵哈特雖然賣力演出，但整部片仍缺乏火花——這是評論觀點，並非蓋棺定論。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times，2026 年 9 月 23 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
亞馬遜新片《愛的假設》（The Love Hypothesis），改編自艾莉‧海澤伍德（Ali Hazelwood）的 BookTok 暢銷小說，由《河谷鎮》女星莉莉‧萊茵哈特（Lili Reinhart）飾演史丹佛生物博士生奧莉薇‧史密斯（Olive Smith），為了向朋友證明論點，跟一名教授假扮情侶。影評普遍認為，萊茵哈特雖然賣力演出，但整部片仍缺乏火花——這是評論觀點，並非蓋棺定論。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 9 月 23 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 有一部新片，評價普通。亞馬遜的《愛的假設》，改編自一部 BookTok 暢銷小說，女主角是演過《河谷鎮》的莉莉‧萊茵哈特，這次演一位史丹佛的生物博士生，為了向朋友證明論點，跟一名教授假扮情侶。影評普遍覺得，萊茵哈特雖然演得賣力，但整部片還是少了點火花——這是評論角度的看法，不是定論。
